description: This file defines the ACLRolesViewClassic class, which extends ViewDetail to handle the display of ACL roles in a classic view within the SuiteCRM project. It customizes the display behavior, disables subpanels, and includes specific PHP files based on the current action.

classes.name: ACLRolesViewClassic
classes.description: A class that manages the classic view for ACL Roles, disabling subpanels and including related PHP files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ACLRolesViewClassic object and disables subpanels.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Processes data and includes the appropriate PHP file for the current action.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the view before display, disabling subpanels again to prevent duplicate display.
